title: Transformers & Attention Mechanisms
summary: The Transformer architecture and self-attention mechanisms form the backbone of modern language models, vision transformers, and multimodal systems.
historicalContext: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) processed text word-by-word, which created a bottleneck since long-term context was lost over long sequences, and training could not be parallelized. This motivated Google researchers in 2017 to invent the Transformer architecture, using self-attention to process entire sequences simultaneously and capture context regardless of distance.

landmarkReferences.title: Attention Is All You Need
landmarkReferences.contribution: Introduced the Transformer architecture and scaled self-attention as a central sequence modeling mechanism.

landmarkReferences.title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
landmarkReferences.contribution: Popularized attention for alignment in neural machine translation.

commonMisconceptions.wrong: The attention mechanism gives the model memory of all previous tokens.
commonMisconceptions.correct: Attention computes weighted relationships between tokens in the current context window. It is a dynamic weighting mechanism, not a persistent memory store. Outside the context window, information is inaccessible.

analogies.text: Self-attention is like a cocktail party where every guest listens to every conversation and focuses only on people speaking about relevant topics.
analogies.limitations: Cocktail guests have conscious intentions, whereas attention heads operate via matrix transformations.

analogies.text: A transformer is like a committee meeting where every participant can talk to every other participant simultaneously. Instead of passing messages in a chain (like RNNs), each participant broadcasts their perspective and everyone else decides how much attention to pay to each broadcast.
analogies.limitations: The committee analogy captures parallel attention but undersells the mathematical machinery of query-key-value computations and multi-head attention.

curiosityFacts: Did you know that the self-attention mechanism was originally designed for neural machine translation, not general generative modeling? Its breakthrough was letting models translate words without respecting sequential order.
The Transformer architecture emerged at Google in 2017 because the team was frustrated by recurrent network training speeds.
storySeeds: The field shifted from local statistical language patterns (n-grams) to continuous dense embeddings, culminating in unified generative transformer models.
Transformers displaced recurrent networks by parallelizing sequence training, enabling researchers to scale models to billions of parameters and terabytes of text.
